content: Generate only JSON cycle actions for the fixed depth-16 FIFO specification checker. You may change stimulus only. The DUT, checker, clock/reset driver, coverage denominator, and cycle budget are fixed. Each action is applied before a rising edge. Maximize uncovered DUT line and branch counters, including distinct source locations, within the cycle limit. A checker finding on faulty RTL is useful evidence; do not suppress it. Return JSON only with an actions array and no prose.
